sources.entry: stable-baselines3 - PyTorch implementations of Stable Baselines (deep) reinforcement learning algorithms.

summary.one_liner: Stable Baselines3 (SB3) is a PyTorch library of reliable implementations of reinforcement learning algorithms, intended as a base for research and comparison.
summary.what_it_does: Provides PyTorch implementations of common deep RL algorithms (such as A2C, PPO, DQN, SAC, TD3, DDPG and HER) behind a sklearn-like interface, where models are created, trained with learn(), and queried with predict(). Supports Box, Discrete, MultiDiscrete and MultiBinary action spaces, and Dict observation spaces, per the README's feature table and algorithm table. Includes custom environments, custom policies, custom callbacks, TensorBoard support and type hints. The README says the core is now in maintenance mode, with new algorithms added in the separate SB3-Contrib repo and faster Jax variants in SBX. It also points to the RL Baselines3 Zoo, a training framework with scripts for training, evaluation, hyperparameter tuning and video recording, and to a migration guide from Stable-Baselines (SB2).
use_cases: training a reinforcement learning agent on a Gymnasium environment
benchmarking RL algorithms against each other
prototyping new RL ideas on top of a tested baseline
teaching beginners RL with a simple API
training agents on Atari games with optional extras
notable: Sklearn-like API: create a model, call learn(), then predict() with a single line
Companion repos: SB3-Contrib for experimental algorithms (e.g. RecurrentPPO, Maskable PPO, TQC) and SBX for a Jax version
RL Baselines3 Zoo provides tuned hyperparameters and trained agents for common environments
Stated performance testing of each algorithm, with results on each algorithm's documentation page
Integrations with Weights & Biases and Hugging Face Hub
caveats: The README says SB3 assumes prior knowledge of reinforcement learning
Core development is focused on bug fixes and maintenance; new algorithms live in SB3-Contrib
No technical support or consulting is provided, per the README
Windows installation is covered only in the external documentation
